description: Small human-calibration set used to sanity-check whether the ReplyLens automated overall score tracks human judgment. Ratings were assigned by a single reviewer (the project author) on a 1-5 scale while building this project, and are NOT a substitute for a proper multi-annotator study. See README 'Metric Validation' section for caveats.

rating_scale.2: Poor - major gaps or errors, needs significant rework
rating_scale.4: Good - close to ready to send as-is
rating_scale.5: Excellent - resolves the issue clearly and completely

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I'd like to request a refund for order ORD-48213. The wireless headphones I received don't work at all.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thanks for reaching out. I'm sorry the wireless headphones didn't work as expected. I've initiated a refund for order ORD-48213; you should see the amount back in your account within 5-7 business days.
cases.notes: Directly addresses the request, gives a concrete next step and timeline, no invented facts.

cases.incoming_email: Hello, I'm not happy with my recent purchase (ORD-77410). I'd like a full refund for the standing desk, please.
cases.generated_response: Hi, thanks for your message. We're sorry to hear that.
cases.notes: Acknowledges dissatisfaction but never actually processes or mentions the refund - not actionable.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, can you tell me the status of my order ORD-19938? I placed it on March 4 and haven't heard anything.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thanks for checking in. Order ORD-19938 is currently being processed and is on track to ship soon. You'll receive a tracking number by email once it leaves our warehouse.
cases.notes: Good, actionable, professional. Slightly generic ('on track') without a firmer date, so not a 5.

cases.incoming_email: Hello, the notebook set I ordered (ORD-52290) is significantly delayed. Where is it?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, your order ORD-52290 was delivered on February 2nd and a $45.00 discount has been applied to your next purchase as compensation.
cases.notes: Fabricates a delivery date and a discount that were never mentioned or authorized - a clear hallucination.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I can't log into my account anymore. It keeps saying my credentials are invalid. Can you help?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, sorry for the trouble logging in. I've unlocked your account - please try logging in again, and use the 'Forgot Password' link if you'd like to set a new password.
cases.notes: Clear, actionable, professional. Doesn't ask for any account-identifying info first, which a stricter reviewer might flag, so 4 not 5.

cases.incoming_email: Hello, I'd like to reset my password but I'm not receiving the reset link. What can I do?
cases.generated_response: reset password check spam folder wait 10 min try again if not working contact us
cases.notes: Content is roughly right but no greeting, sign-off, or professional tone - reads like a note, not a reply.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I noticed a charge on my statement I don't recognize for order ORD-30012. Can you explain this?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thanks for flagging this. I looked into order ORD-30012 and the charge reflects the item price plus applicable tax. I've attached a breakdown for clarity - let me know if anything still looks off.
cases.notes: Helpful and specific, but claims to attach a breakdown that isn't actually possible in an email body - minor overreach.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I was charged twice for order ORD-88221. Can you refund the duplicate charge?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, I'm sorry for the duplicate charge on order ORD-88221. I've confirmed it was billed twice in error and have refunded the extra charge; it should appear in 5-7 business days.
cases.notes: Textbook resolution: acknowledges, confirms the error, takes action, gives a timeline.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I'd like to cancel my subscription. Please make sure I'm not billed again.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thanks for reaching out! We're sad to see you go. Here are 3 reasons you might want to stay: our new features, our loyalty discounts, and our community events!
cases.notes: Ignores the explicit cancellation request entirely and pivots to retention messaging - does not resolve the issue.

cases.incoming_email: Hi team, I have a few questions about the office chair before I order it.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, happy to help! Could you let me know which specific questions you have about the office chair - for example sizing, materials, or warranty - so I can give you accurate details?
cases.notes: Appropriately asks for clarification instead of inventing specs, which is the right call given the vague email. Docked slightly for not offering any general info up front.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I'm really unhappy with the service I received regarding order ORD-61120. This isn't the experience I expected.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, I'm sorry to hear about your experience with order ORD-61120 - that falls short of what we aim for. I've escalated this to our support lead and will personally follow up to make sure it's resolved.
cases.notes: Empathetic, takes ownership, gives a concrete escalation path.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, my bluetooth speaker isn't connecting properly. I've tried restarting it but no luck. Can you help?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, sorry for the trouble. Could you try resetting the speaker by holding the power button for 10 seconds, then reconnecting via Bluetooth? Let me know if that resolves it or if you'd like a video walkthrough.
cases.notes: Concrete troubleshooting step plus an offer for more help - genuinely actionable.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I need to update the shipping address for order ORD-40551 before it ships. Can you help?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, I've updated the shipping address for order ORD-40551 as requested.
cases.notes: Correct and actionable, but doesn't confirm the new address or say whether the order had already shipped, which the original email specifically worried about.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I'd like to exchange the running shoes from order ORD-27788 for a different size. How do I do that?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, of course! I've started an exchange for order ORD-27788 - a prepaid return label is on its way to your email, and we'll ship the replacement as soon as the original is on its way back to us.
cases.notes: Complete, actionable, sets correct expectations about sequencing.

cases.incoming_email: Hello, I received my air purifier today (order ORD-59901) but it arrived damaged. What are my options?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thank you for your email! Your feedback is important to us.
cases.notes: Pure acknowledgment with zero substance - does not even mention damage, replacement, or refund.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I need to cancel order ORD-15599 before it ships. Is that still possible?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, I've cancelled order ORD-15599 for you. Since it hadn't shipped yet, no charges will be applied and any pending authorization will be released within a few business days.
cases.notes: Directly answers the question asked ('is that still possible') and confirms outcome plus timeline.

cases.incoming_email: Hi team, there seems to be a billing error on my account related to order ORD-33410.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, I've charged your card an additional $120.00 to correct the billing error, as per our updated pricing policy effective this month.
cases.notes: Fabricates both an amount and a policy that were never mentioned - actively harmful hallucination, charges the customer more.

cases.incoming_email: Hello, does the smart watch come with a warranty? I'm considering buying one.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thanks for your interest in the smart watch. It comes with a 1-year limited warranty and detailed specs are listed on the product page. Let me know if you have any other questions before ordering.
cases.notes: Answers the exact question, points to more info, invites follow-up - no unsupported specifics beyond what's plausible pre-sale info.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, my order ORD-90212 was supposed to arrive by June 10 but it still hasn't shown up. Can you check what's going on?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, I'm sorry for the delay with order ORD-90212. I've checked with our shipping partner and it looks like there was a delay in transit. I've flagged this for priority handling and will follow up with an updated delivery date shortly.
cases.notes: Solid and appropriately hedged ('will follow up'), but customer is left without any timeframe at all for the follow-up itself.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I'm having trouble setting up my desk lamp. The instructions don't seem to match what I'm seeing.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Please refer to page 12 of the manual, section 4.3, for detailed setup steps including the wiring diagram for the EU 3-prong variant.
cases.notes: Invents specific manual page/section/product-variant details that cannot be known from the email - confident-sounding hallucination.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I forgot my password and the reset email isn't arriving. Can you help me regain access?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, sorry about that. I've resent the password reset link to your registered email. If it doesn't show up shortly, I can reset it manually from our end.
cases.notes: Clear action taken, plus a fallback path if the first fix doesn't work.

cases.incoming_email: Hi, I entered the wrong address on order ORD-70043. Can this be corrected?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, unfortunately once an order is placed the address cannot ever be changed under any circumstances, and there is nothing we can do.
cases.notes: Overly absolute and unhelpful - most orders can still be corrected pre-shipment; response doesn't even check shipping status before refusing.

cases.incoming_email: Hi team, I want to formally complain about how my recent order (ORD-58821) was handled.
cases.generated_response: Hi there, thank you for your patience and for letting us know. I've logged your feedback about order ORD-58821 and escalated it internally so we can prevent this going forward.
cases.notes: Professional and takes it seriously, but stays generic about what specifically will happen next.

cases.incoming_email: Hello, my yoga mat order (ORD-24471) arrived with a small tear. Can I get a replacement?
cases.generated_response: Hi there, I'm sorry to hear the yoga mat arrived damaged. I can send a free replacement or process a full refund for order ORD-24471, whichever you'd prefer.
cases.notes: Empathetic, offers a real choice, no invented details.
